subject: RL-H25 P2.2 native force API verified; RL-H25 recovery still underexcited
body: Read robotis-lab master PR#8 (merged SHA 5764732...) and draft docs PR#9. Webots native force API probe 8/8 PASS in Actions run 39713137894, actual R2025a; offline 99 tests PASS, native smoke PASS. Actual RL-H25 pitch+ 0.10N 0.112s 7 steps baseline peak .00012rad vs PID .00016rad, both INCONCLUSIVE relative to .008rad. P2.2 NOT_ACCEPTED, P3 blocked; inspect docs/experiments/p2-2-acceptance-report.md (PR#9) and docs/OPERATOR_HANDOFF.md. Operator must verify foot contact. Next approved work: cautiously diagnose inadequate excitation; consider 0.15N bounded pitch+ pilot only after safety review, 0.20N only if preceding safe; no PID tuning until measurable response, no unsafe hardware or automatic gait. Do not merge draft PR#9 without review.
